name: orgai-code-agent
description: Chat-based coding agent backed by a local Python tool-calling loop

orgai.sendEditorContext.description: Send the active file name, your selection, the cursor line and that file's errors and warnings with each message.

enumDescriptions: Ask before every file edit and command.
Apply file edits without asking (each diff is still shown in the chat); still ask before commands.
orgai.approvalMode.description: When OrgAI may act without asking you first. User setting only, so a repository can't change it.

orgai.allowedCommands.markdownDescription: Commands OrgAI may run without asking, e.g. `npm test` or `git status`. An entry also allows extra arguments (`npm test` allows `npm test -- --watch=false`). Commands containing `&`, `|`, `;`, `<`, `>`, `` ` ``, `$(` or a line break always ask. User setting only, so a repository can't change it.
